summary: One navigation state. New workbench/living_nav.py: stable ids for plain files and folders in Files ('fileid:<32 hex>', kept in the Kernel's own database, table living_objects, keyed by device+inode with the content digest as the check; renames and moves keep the id, an editor's save-over keeps it, a move across disks is found by digest, an inode reused by other content gets a new id), two read operations objects.files and objects.get, and the pure Navigator (focus, depth board/work/split, pane, history entries holding the board's zoom and place, the document's scroll and cursor, and how the place was reached; Back/Forward). New workbench/living_nav_qt.py wires the window: the Files tab's tree gains a Files drawer (the Files folder, one row per object id) and a Desk drawer (the board's records by their own ids, grouped Sources/Sheets/Calculations/Pages/Findings/Questions/Goals...); a click in the tree focuses the object on the board (the Field, until L2) with a plain file drawn as a FILE tile wired 'same bytes' to its admitted source; a board selection reveals the object in the tree (parents opened, nothing closed, scroll moved only as needed); Search results do the same; a breadcrumb bar above the centre (Back and Forward chevrons, then the trail and name, each folder a place to go) follows renames seen by a QFileSystemWatcher or done by Graphite's own files.rename/move/trash/restore; Back/Forward (and Alt+Left/Alt+Right, never printed) restore an entry whole.

decisions: The left tree is the existing Files tab's tree (the cabinet tree): L1 adds two drawers under Concern, 'Files' (the workspace's Files folder) and 'Desk' (the board's records), injected in the window layer (cabinet_qt.refresh calls living_nav_qt.extend), not in the ledger.cabinet Kernel operation, so the cabinet's Kernel output and its tests are untouched. Both drawers start closed, so the tree's first rows are as before.

The centre's board is the Field (field_page) until L2's board_qt lands: selection syncs both ways through FieldView.selection_changed (only selections made by the owner's mouse or keys move the history) and a wrapped FieldView.set_field (instance attribute) that draws the focused plain file or folder as a FILE/FOLDER tile when it is not a desk record.
A plain file and the admitted source made from it are two objects (the source is a snapshot copy); the board wires them 'same bytes' only when the file's full SHA-256 equals the source's.

Digests: files up to 32 MB by full SHA-256, larger ones by a sampled digest (size, first and last MB, said 'sampled'); a digest is read at once only where it decides something, the rest at most 48 MB per reading of Files ('pending' until then, the inode deciding meanwhile), so a large Files never stalls the window on its first reading. Symlinks and machine files are not objects.

Graphite's own moves tell the identity store at once (files_service.carried); a rename by another program is seen by a QFileSystemWatcher on the listed folders (150 ms debounce) and by the tree's own 2.5 s refresh.

The Field opens a sheet on one click (0.8.x); L1 leaves that as it is (L4 owns 'single click focuses, double-click opens'). A click on a tile therefore records two history entries (the focus on the board, then the work depth), and Back goes through both.
History is kept for the window's session only (not saved); an entry whose tab was closed is reopened on Back through the object's own opener; Field arrow-key moves each make an entry.

Back/Forward also on Alt+Left/Alt+Right (QShortcut on the window); no key is printed on screen (tooltips say 'Back to <name>'). The breadcrumb leaves out the root (Concern); a long trail loses its middle first ('…'); the 'renamed from' note gets only the room the trail leaves.
findings_for_the_coordinator: Merge points: shell2.install has one marked line after install_panes; cabinet_qt.refresh/clicked/open, console_qt.reveal_record, field_page.open_object and files_service each have small marked hooks; engineering_kernel/engineering_cli/activity blocks are commented '1.0 L1'. docs/GRAPHITE_0.1_REGISTRY.json adds objects.files and objects.get (regenerate at merge).

For L2 (board): focus through host.living_nav.go(ident, 'board', 'board', from_board=True) on a tile selection, and draw the focused plain file via living_nav_qt.LivingNav.with_focus (or its own tile); history entries carry board={'zoom','x','y','face','auto','whole'} today, read by board_state/set_board: the new board should provide the same two calls.

For L4/L5: a working view may define document_position()/set_document_position(place) and the history will use it; tabs carry _living_oid for their object; depth 'split' is recorded when the existing split_panel is visible, the pane is 'main' until L5 says which pane is active. Her column's 'This:' still follows the current tab rather than the board's focus (seen in the kasandra frames) - L5/P1.

Possible existing-test sensitivity (not run, by the rule): tests that count the cabinet tree's rows or click its empty bottom area (tests_integrated/test_context_menu.py 'the_trees_refresh...' clicks 4 px above the tree's bottom expecting no row) see two more collapsed rows (Files, Desk) under Concern.

A brief written from the Field (B) while a FILE tile is drawn would include that tile; its fingerprint then differs from a later reading without it (it would show 'the desk changed'). Rare; the L2 board replaces this path.
The breadcrumb's font size is set when the window is built; a reading-size change at run time is not followed until restart.

release_note: One centre, one selection: the Files tree and the board now share one focus by the object's identity, not its name. Choose a file in Files and the board shows it; choose something on the board and the tree opens its folders to it without closing the others. A file renamed or moved, by Graphite or by another program, stays the same object, and its new name shows in the tree, on the board and in the new breadcrumb above the centre. Back and Forward (beside the breadcrumb) return to where you were with the board's size and the document's place as you left them. Built, not tested.
